title: CogBattery: Human-Referenced Evaluation of Cognitive Task Behavior and Structure in Language Models
author: Dengzhe Hou, Lingyu Jiang, Fangzhou Lin, Kazunori D Yamada

summary: Human cognitive tasks let us compare language models with humans under controlled conditions. Yet a model can reproduce the direction of a human effect while making different errors.
takeaways: CogBattery evaluates 54 open-weight language models on text adaptations of 13 cognitive paradigms, comparing each with human data from its source study.
CogBattery provides condition-level human references for testing errors and confidence reports in new models.
Yet a model can reproduce the direction of a human effect while making different errors.
